This dated state record names the data-centre project, its applicant and its address, so it is recorded as announced on 26 October 2026. The draft air permit covers the source's new emission units (potential emissions limited below the Title V and PSD major thresholds); it is not yet issued and is not a building or zoning consent for the data centre, so permitted status is not claimed.
